The ninth R/Pharma conference has wrapped up.  Four days of workshops (24 workshops plus a hackathon) and two days of conference presentations across Europe/US and APAC time zones.  A huge **thank you** to all the workshop and conference presenters.  

Recordings will follow shortly.
